_comment: Regional price table. Amounts are in the currency of the group, NOT converted by an
exchange rate: each group states the price you actually want to charge there.
Resolution order is region query param -> country header (CF-IPCountry / X-Country) ->
Accept-Language region subtag -> default. Edit freely; every entry is a business decision.
"prices" are the subscription plans; "websiteOrders" are the one-off project services
checkout.html sells (slugs live in lib/website-orders.js). A websiteOrder slug that is
missing from a group makes that service unavailable there rather than quietly charging
the default group's number in the wrong currency.
The Free plan is always 0 and comes from data/services.json.
